purpose: One in-sample raw-generation check on two fixed short real-source training examples, to distinguish failure to generate learned structures from cross-family transfer before any new fit or training-data change.
speed: default/standard required; tool has no per-turn tier field. Historical fit assignment model/effort remains unchanged.
split: train only; frozen families retain original membership. No relabelling to development and no evaluation files opened or staged.
inference: Original SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt_messages, tokenizer chat template, SETTINGS and greedy generation code/settings; explicit local base plus exact saved adapter, no query-attention fit override, fitting or data-target feedback in this process.
modelVisibleInputs: Only the two unchanged selected input evidence keys/text, in original order. No teacher explanations/target outputs, no independent expectations, no development or held-out contents in the model prompt.
hostComparison: Validate raw responses unchanged with original schema/citation/literal checks against train membership. Compare accepted claims/citations/conflicts/abstentions to the already accepted provisional teacher targets on the host after inference; separate schema validity, exact source-native claim coverage, extra claims, unknown-null behavior, required abstentions and literal preservation. Report 2 examples/2 families/7 expected claims and undefined precision if none accepted. This is training reconstruction, never independent source accuracy or generalization.
interpretation: If trained-family raw generation also fails, return those concrete errors before another fit. If it passes, current evidence supports a format/family coverage gap; no automatic data expansion, constrained decoding or new model fit is authorized by this diagnostic.
implementation: New leaf diagnostic/staging logic and narrow association_adapter reload dispatch if needed, using existing containment action/arguments and exact accepted-fit loader. Do not mutate student.py baseline/inference functions, old run/freeze files, shared model_isolation/resources/security primitives or third-party/dependency sources. Any reused supervisor completion qualification string is generic legacy metadata, not authority: emit authoritative train-only diagnostic scope and explicitly disclose that fixed field without claiming a new development result.
verification: Review owned delta; focused split/target-isolation and byte-pin checks only, then the one actual diagnostic. No repeated fit/control/source campaigns. No fake development split to reuse validation.
teacherFeedback: Return only train-case predictions/errors to coordinator; coordinator may then provide concrete train-only feedback to teacher. Teacher remains idle during this run.
ownership: Same sole learner/GPU owner; primary staging and coordinator schema/freeze/status/assignments are read-only. Preserve all original and successful/failed-run bytes.
